en-GB.title: Quoter: Quotes and Motivation
en-GB.shortDescription: Read inspiring quotes offline, save favourites, listen and share
en-GB.fullDescription:
Find a little perspective in your day with Quoter, a minimalist quotes app for reading, reflection and motivation. Explore thousands of quotes in a quiet monochrome reader, with your favourites close at hand.

READ AND DISCOVER
Browse quotes by topic, or search for words and authors. The bundled collection is available offline, so you can keep reading without waiting for a network connection.

KEEP YOUR FAVOURITES
Save the quotes you want to return to. Quotes and Saved have separate reading positions, making it easy to switch between discovering something different and revisiting a favourite.

LISTEN AT YOUR OWN PACE
Hear quotes through your device's on-device text-to-speech engine. Choose from compatible installed offline voices and adjust speech speed. Available voices depend on your device and speech engine; voice selection does not translate the quote text.

SHARE A QUOTE
Share a quote as an image with its author and attributed text through Android's sharing menu.

MAKE TIME FOR REFLECTION
Set a daily quote reminder at a time that suits you. Choose text or image-style notifications.

A READER THAT FITS YOUR SCREEN
Use Light, Dark or Automatic appearance. Turn glass controls on or off and adjust their transparency. On supported unfolded and tablet layouts, open Browse or Settings beside the reader while keeping your quote in view.

Quoter keeps the focus on the words, with bold typography and a simple reading experience.

Feedback: adhikaridayamoy@gmail.com

releaseNotes.text: A refreshed monochrome reader with offline quotes, searchable topics and authors, saved favourites, on-device listening and direct image sharing. New grouped settings, adjustable glass, daily reminders and supporting panes on unfolded and tablet screens.
